item.title: GRIZZLY NIGHT Interview: Matt Lintz Explains The Biggest Challenges Of His Latest Horror Role (Exclusive)
item.description: The Walking Dead star Matt Lintz talks to us about his role in Grizzly Night, an intense new horror-thriller that sees the actor go to some very dark places after a horrifying bear attack.

item.title: X-MEN: OUTBACK Comic Series Will Return To One Of UNCANNY X-MEN's Most Beloved Eras
item.description: This May, Steve Orlando and Stephen Segovia deliver an all-new saga set during the X-Men's beloved Australian Outback era in X-Men: Outback, and we have a first look and details.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Rumor Makes A Case For Sadie Sink Playing [SPOILER]
item.description: New details about Sadie Sink's Spider-Man: Brand New Day character have been revealed, and all signs are pointing to the Stranger Things alum playing this key Marvel hero.

item.title: Road To AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY: 5 Movies The MCU Could Have Done Better By Actually Using The Multiverse
item.description: The Multiverse Saga of the MCU has been a mess of inconsistency, but among the massive catalog entries we sifted through to discover which features could have benefitted from a different approach.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Spoilers Reveal Two Major Character Deaths (And Fans Won't Be Happy)
item.description: A new Avengers: Doomsday rumour claims to reveal two major character deaths during the movie's first act, and many fans won't be happy to say goodbye to these two fan-favourites.

item.title: PSYCHO KILLER: "Devilishly Dull" Slasher Movie From SE7EN Writer Hits Rotten Tomatoes... With 0%
item.description: Psycho Killer is now in theaters, and the review embargo lifted shortly before the movie's release. It's fair to say critics weren't overly impressed with this one...
